name: Nethermind
about:
faceless, fact-checked YouTube Shorts on Marvel/comics history, anime, gaming,
space and strange animals; the best format so far is "a comic power that's real biology".
subscribe_line: Subscribe for the buried history behind comics, anime, games and the real science hiding inside them.
replies_about: Marvel history, space and weird animals

identity.tone: like a caffeinated raccoon: high-energy, gleeful, rummaging for the weird bit; low-key geek — knows the lore, never gatekeeps or shows off
identity.voice: curious, direct, a little dry — a knowledgeable friend, never a lecture; no scripted catchphrases, sounds like the creator talking naturally
identity.viewer_promise: genuinely strange things that are actually true, explained fast — always fact-checked and sourced
do_words: following this vibe, what are the options
dont_words: rage-bait framing ("they don't want you to know")
filler intros ("hey guys, in today's video")
circle of life / nature is metal clichés
curiosity-gap clickbait the video doesn't pay off
